reason_for_followup: Two runs contain files named confirmation_metrics.csv and confirmation_verdict.json, so filename-only scanning could incorrectly classify them as confirmation exposure.
interpretation: Both confirmation_metrics.csv files are explicit NOT_RUN placeholders. Their ledgers contain only fit/inner/outer accesses and no confirmation role. They are not evidence of confirmation data exposure.
claim_boundary: This resolves only the two 20260907 paper_results filenames. It does not prove that every uninstrumented loader or neutrally named historical asset avoided the 42/84 confirmation pools.
